booking_reassignment_resolution_check.name: booking_reassignment_resolution_check
booking_reassignment_resolution_check.value:
(resolved_at IS NULL AND resolution IS NULL AND resolved_by_id IS NULL)
        OR (resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolution IS NOT NULL)

branch_owner_is_not_manager_check.name: branch_owner_is_not_manager_check
branch_owner_is_not_manager_check.value: owner_user_id IS NULL OR manager_user_id IS NULL OR owner_user_id <> manager_user_id

invoice_snapshot_check.name: invoice_snapshot_check
invoice_snapshot_check.value:
"invoice"."tax_point_at" IS NULL OR (
        "invoice"."financial_year" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$'
        AND "invoice"."sequence_number" > 0
        AND "invoice"."tax_review_status" IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoice"."issuer_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoice"."issuer_address" IS NOT NULL
        AND "invoice"."cgst_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice"."sgst_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice"."cgst_paise" + "invoice"."sgst_paise" = "invoice"."gst_amount_paise"
        AND "invoice"."taxable_value_paise" + "invoice"."gst_amount_paise" = "invoice"."total_amount_paise"
        AND char_length("invoice"."invoice_number") <= 16
      )

invoice_item_tax_check.name: invoice_item_tax_check
invoice_item_tax_check.value:
"invoice_item"."tax_version_id" IS NULL OR (
        "invoice_item"."sac_code" ~ '^[0-9]{6}$'
        AND "invoice_item"."rate_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 2800
        AND "invoice_item"."discount_paise" BETWEEN 0 AND "invoice_item"."total_price_paise"
        AND "invoice_item"."taxable_value_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice_item"."tax_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice_item"."taxable_value_paise" + "invoice_item"."tax_paise" = "invoice_item"."total_price_paise" - "invoice_item"."discount_paise"
        AND "invoice_item"."cgst_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice_item"."sgst_paise" >= 0
        AND "invoice_item"."cgst_paise" + "invoice_item"."sgst_paise" = "invoice_item"."tax_paise"
      )

loyalty_transaction_expires_at_idx.name: loyalty_transaction_expires_at_idx
loyalty_transaction_expires_at_idx.where: type = 'earned' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

loyalty_transaction_amount_check.name: loyalty_transaction_amount_check
loyalty_transaction_amount_check.value: CASE WHEN "loyalty_transaction"."type" = 'expired' THEN "loyalty_transaction"."gems_amount" < 0 WHEN "loyalty_transaction"."type" = 'adjusted' THEN "loyalty_transaction"."gems_amount" <> 0 ELSE "loyalty_transaction"."gems_amount" > 0 END

staff_profile_role_witness_check.name: staff_profile_role_witness_check
staff_profile_role_witness_check.value: role_witness IS NULL OR role_witness IN ('staff', 'receptionist', 'manager')

staff_profile_designation_matches_role_c.name: staff_profile_designation_matches_role_check
staff_profile_designation_matches_role_c.value:
role_witness IS NULL
        OR (role_witness = 'manager' AND designation = 'manager')
        OR (role_witness = 'receptionist' AND designation = 'receptionist')
        OR (role_witness = 'staff' AND designation IN ('stylist', 'therapist'))

staff_profile_branch_by_role_check.name: staff_profile_branch_by_role_check
staff_profile_branch_by_role_check.value:
role_witness IS NULL
        OR (role_witness = 'manager' AND branch_id IS NULL)
        OR (role_witness IN ('staff', 'receptionist') AND branch_id IS NOT NULL)

branch_settlement_net_check.name: branch_settlement_net_check
branch_settlement_net_check.value:
"branch_settlement"."net_paise" = abs(("branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_gems_paise") - ("branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_gems_paise"))
        AND CASE
          WHEN ("branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_gems_paise") > ("branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_gems_paise")
            THEN "branch_settlement"."paying_branch_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "branch_settlement"."branch_a_id"
             AND "branch_settlement"."receiving_branch_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "branch_settlement"."branch_b_id"
          WHEN ("branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."a_owes_b_gems_paise") < ("branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_membership_paise" + "branch_settlement"."b_owes_a_gems_paise")
            THEN "branch_settlement"."paying_branch_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "branch_settlement"."branch_b_id"
             AND "branch_settlement"."receiving_branch_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "branch_settlement"."branch_a_id"
          ELSE "branch_settlement"."paying_branch_id" IS NULL AND "branch_settlement"."receiving_branch_id" IS NULL
        END

branch_settlement_paid_check.name: branch_settlement_paid_check
branch_settlement_paid_check.value:
("branch_settlement"."paid_on" IS NULL AND "branch_settlement"."payment_reference" IS NULL
           AND "branch_settlement"."paid_recorded_by" IS NULL AND "branch_settlement"."paid_recorded_at" IS NULL
           AND NOT "branch_settlement"."internal_transfer")
        OR ("branch_settlement"."paid_on" IS NOT NULL AND "branch_settlement"."payment_reference" IS NOT NULL
           AND length(btrim("branch_settlement"."payment_reference")) > 0
           AND "branch_settlement"."paid_recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND "branch_settlement"."paid_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL
           AND "branch_settlement"."net_paise" > 0)

settlement_entry_shape_check.name: settlement_entry_shape_check
settlement_entry_shape_check.value:
CASE "settlement_entry"."kind"
        WHEN 'membership_session' THEN
          "settlement_entry"."spa_membership_id" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_entry"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."minutes" > 0 AND "settlement_entry"."gems" IS NULL AND "settlement_entry"."gem_value_paise" IS NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."loyalty_transaction_id" IS NULL AND "settlement_entry"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."value_paise" >= 0
          AND "settlement_entry"."gst_share_paise" >= 0 AND "settlement_entry"."gst_share_paise" <= "settlement_entry"."value_paise"
        WHEN 'gems_redemption' THEN
          "settlement_entry"."loyalty_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_entry"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."gems" > 0 AND "settlement_entry"."gem_value_paise" > 0 AND "settlement_entry"."minutes" IS NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."spa_membership_id" IS NULL AND "settlement_entry"."reverses_entry_id" IS NULL
          AND "settlement_entry"."value_paise" = "settlement_entry"."gems"::bigint * "settlement_entry"."gem_value_paise"
          AND "settlement_entry"."gst_share_paise" = 0
        WHEN 'reversal' THEN
          "settlement_entry"."reverses_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "settlement_entry"."note" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(btrim("settlement_entry"."note")) > 0
          AND "settlement_entry"."value_paise" <= 0
          AND "settlement_entry"."gst_share_paise" <= 0 AND "settlement_entry"."gst_share_paise" >= "settlement_entry"."value_paise"
        ELSE false
      END
